newsitem.title: UK: Nat Express Q2 E. Midlands passengers rise.
newsitem.headline: Nat Express Q2 E. Midlands passengers rise.

text.p: British transport company National Express Group Plc said on Friday that passenger numbers at East Midlands Airport rose 1.1 percent in the second quarter of this year to 528,000.
The company said the underlying increase in passenger numbers for May and June was 5.3 percent. Cargo throughput rose 22.4 percent in the second quarter to 35,000 tonnes.
At Bournemouth Airport, passenger numbers rose 99 percent to 118,000.

"With the completion of the winter inclusive tour programmes for 1996/97, it is encouraging to report underlying growth of 5.3 per cent in the first two months of the 1997 summer inclusive tour programmes at East Midlands," National Express chief executive Phil White said.
White said scheduled services continued to perform well and would be enhanced in September when Air UK launches a new service from East Midlands to Amsterdam.
National Express said its coach, bus and train divisions continued to perform in line with expectations.
